changes: StrokeColor stores extended-range sRGB (-2...2, alpha 0...1); Display P3 palette colors render, export and round-trip; conversion rounding within half an 8-bit step snaps to sRGB
Display P3 output for wide-gamut sources or annotation colors, sRGB otherwise; pixelation tiles and capture previews keep source gamut
Annotation fields, handle and object accessibility values use visible rotated axes, matching crop fields
Caption retries quietly while busy (2 s) or not ready (30 s); cancelled with the view
Undo/Redo availability includes a pending inspector edit
Pinch zoom anchored at the pinch point; menu/accessibility zoom anchored at the visible center
One Paste per window registers Cmd-V; removed unused insets, pixelatedPreview and inspector presentation path; cleanup no longer replaces original errors
32-point bottom-ornament clearance below the image column and as sidebar/inspector scroll margins; caption aligned with the 36-point canvas inset
Paired dimension fields show labels above values so Width/Height share a row in the 380-point inspector
Color well binding returns value-equal Color(.sRGB) values; a CGColor-backed getter intermittently dropped palette selections

UI tests: shared revealInInspector/editMenuAction helpers, native toggle queries, collapsed Recents expansion, picker-dismissal wait, compact Drawing Tools menu, rotated-field, pending-Undo, busy-caption and caption-clearance assertions
